thread:
laura: hey hi! starting today, quick ask: need access to the Console Environment Panel. goal: QA admin so i can validate onboarding flag flows, prod readonly for runbooks. who do i ping for the fastest route?
ida: welcome laura :wave: open an infra-permissions ticket with manager approval. infra usually follows the template below and can do it same day if manager signs off.
laura: paste the template pls?
ida: here's what to include:
```
Title: Env panel access request - laura
Requester: laura
Manager: <name>
Environments: qa (admin), prod (readonly)
Reason: onboarding tests + runbook verification
Duration: 14 days (extend if needed)
Rollback plan: none, readonly in prod only
```
sam: also add which flags you expect to touch and any rollout ids. infra will lock admin toggles to qa unless a temporary exception is requested.
laura: cool, opened ticket (#INF-4758) and added manager approval. linked the onboarding flag doc.
access-bot: system note: once infra updates roles, confirm via Console -> top-right avatar -> "My permissions" OR API: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://console.internal/api/v1/me/roles` to check for `\"env_panel\": \"admin\"` in qa and `\"env_panel\": \"readonly\"` in prod.
laura: infra updated my access. i see qa admin but prod still shows viewer.
ida: thanks for confirming. prod readonly requires SCIM group sync; i've kicked a sync and asked infra to re-run. should be done in ~30m.
sam: one more tip: for any flag flips during your shadow run, coordinate with me so we can monitor metrics.
access-bot: reminder: all admin flips in qa are logged to /logs/flags and subject to rollback if a canary fails.
laura: got it — thanks everyone, feel free to drop the onboarding checklist here when ready. :smile:
